risk.rationale: No verified findings survive for prof.kaya@aegean.edu. Every suspicious signal raised against this account was rejected with a valid critic explanation: the Turkey/Lisbon 'impossible travel' and session-token-replay rows are non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync tokens, not interactive person sign-ins; the Turkcell/193.140.10.21 ASN is the organisation's shared egress (202 distinct accounts completed MFA from it in 30 days, above the 10-account threshold), so it is not a new personal network or coordinated spray (54-account failures are background noise); the VPN KEV concerns either apply to already-patched firmware 22.7R2.8 or to vpn-edge-01, which carried no sign-in for this account. With no surviving findings and no data-quality conflicts, the suspicious signals are fully explained away.
